column1: # box_datasets.tsv - where an archive dest-name is extracted locally.
# Only needed for dest-names that do NOT mirror a path under $HOME. Dest-names under
# archive/alpha-data/... map automatically to CACHE_ROOT/alpha-data/... (same relative path),
# including the nested datasets delayed_sip_iex/, quote_universe_acquire/ and the live tree
#   * live paths (data/..., alpha-data/...) are paths the code reads unchanged through the
#   * restore/... paths are COLD restores: archives of a tree that no longer exists locally.
#     They never land on a live path, so pulling one can never overwrite current state.
# `box pull <dest>` extracts into CACHE_ROOT/<path below>; override per run with --to DIR.
# `box get <dest>` copies a single-object dataset (git bundle / session tar) there instead.
# Keep the tabs. Comments (#) and blank lines are ignored.
